parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols ldp traffic-eng tunnels.explanation: 在LDP协议中启用流量工程隧道。

set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.template: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface [parameter1]
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.command: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface ge-1/0/0.0
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.explanation: 将接口ge-1/0/0.0添加到MPLS TE隧道组1中。

set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.template: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface [parameter1]
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.command: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface ge-1/0/2.0
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.explanation: 将接口ge-1/0/2.0添加到MPLS TE隧道组1中。

set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.template: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface [parameter1]
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.command: set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 interface ge-1/0/1.0
set protocols mpls te tunnel-group1 inte.explanation: 将接口ge-1/0/1.0添加到MPLS TE隧道组1中。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng bandwidth.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng bandwidth bc [parameter1] tunnel-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng bandwidth.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng bandwidth bc 0 tunnel-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng bandwidth.explanation: 为MPLS流量工程隧道组1配置带宽类0的带宽。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng collectio.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng collection-interval [parameter1] tunnel-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng collectio.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng collection-interval 60 tunnel-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng collectio.explanation: 为MPLS流量工程隧道组1配置收集间隔为60秒。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 收集间隔时间，单位为秒。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng administr.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的管理员权重。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程的自动路由通告。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute metric absolute
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute metric absolute
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的自动路由度量值为绝对。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-tunn.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-tunnel mesh-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-tunn.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-tunnel mesh-group1
set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-tunn.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程的自动隧道网格组1。

set forwarding-plane traffic-eng tunnels.explanation: 在转发平面启用流量工程隧道。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.3.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 2.2.2.2/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-instances net router-id lo0..explanation: 为路由实例配置路由器ID。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器ID，通常为接口名称。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置路由选项中的自治系统号。
